title: VISA Information
body:
France Visa Information

Complete this Form if you require an invitation letter from OpenStack Foundation in order to secure a visa to enter France to attend the Summit.

Before submitting the form please check to see if you are exempt from the French Visa Requirements. 

Requests for invitation letters must be received before October 24, 2014.  Contact events@openstack.org if you have any questions.

You will be asked to provide the following information in the form:

  • Given Name (first name):
  • Family Name (last name):
  • Gender:
  • Nationality:
  • Passport #:
  • Country in which you currently live (location of French Embassy meeting):
  • Date of Birth (Month / Day / Year):
  • Description of involvement with OpenStack:
  • Have you already registered for the Summit - Yes/No:
  • Travel Dates:
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
